tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground of the whole agent panel: thread bar, settings bar, log, composer. Also the text colour on ink fills (the pressed Mode/Model/Thinking segment and the primary Send and Run this step buttons).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Behind inline code and callouts in the agent's rendered answer (.doc-inline code, .doc-inline .callout). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, code-bg and fill: the user's message, the answer, step code and step results. Also the 1px box around the user's message and the off banner, the pressed segment fill, the primary button fill, the running-step dot and the focus outline (2px, offset 1px).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg: the You and Agent labels, control labels (Mode, Model, Thinking), unpressed segments and thread tabs, the step's first line and time, the composer's meta line, Thinking and Working, the revert and copy links, turn notes such as Stopped.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: 1px lines that frame controls and blocks on bg: segment and button borders, the step box, the composer's top rule and textarea border, the thread bar's bottom rule and tab dividers, the 2px left rule of a step result. Below 3:1 on bg in both themes (source value, kept): every framed control also carries a text label, so the line is never the only cue.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The quietest 1px line: under the settings bar, between a step's summary and its body. Decorative only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red for things that need the person: a step waiting for approval (border, blinking dot, the words waiting for you), a step that failed (border, dot, result text), an agent turn that ended in an error (its Agent label), the Stop button, the close × on hover, and the small marker after a lab: link. As text it reads on bg and code-bg in both themes. Never decoration, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Behind step code (pre.src) and inside the composer textarea. Text on it is ink; highlighted tokens use the tok-* colours.

tokens.name: tok-key
tokens.usage: JavaScript keywords in step code (.tk-k, bold), on code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-str
tokens.usage: String literals in step code (.tk-s), on code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-num
tokens.usage: Numbers (.tk-n) and the literals null, true, false, undefined (.tk-b, bold) in step code, on code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-expr
tokens.usage: The lambda arrow => in step code (.tk-e, bold), on code-bg: the workbench's one accent in code. Same value as accent.

tokens.name: tok-com
tokens.usage: Comments in step code (.tk-c, italic), on code-bg. Below 4.5:1 in both themes (source value, kept): comments are meant to recede.

tokens.name: tok-punc
tokens.usage: Punctuation and operators in step code (.tk-p), on code-bg. Below 4.5:1 in both themes (source value, kept): the code's shape reads from ink keywords and names.

groups.name: Panel
groups.note: One family in two weights, 400 and 700. In the app this stack is the variable --mono, a historical name: it is Arial, not a monospace.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Make the kickflip spin faster and check it still lands
styles.usage: The panel's base text: the user's message, the off banner, suggestion buttons, the composer textarea.

styles.name: answer
styles.sample: Measured in fresh worlds before and after the edit, the kickflip still lands.
styles.usage: The agent's rendered Markdown answer (.md.doc-inline). Paragraphs 8px apart.

styles.name: answer-heading
styles.usage: h1 to h3 inside an answer: all one size, 10px above and 4px below, no rule.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small text in ink-2: the You and Agent labels, Mode/Model/Thinking labels, small segments, thread tabs, step summaries and times, the composer meta line, Thinking, turn notes, link buttons.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: The active thread tab, the word eval in a step summary, waiting for you on a step that asks.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Send and Stop (.btn). The small buttons Run this step and Decline (.btn.sm) use label size.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The system monospace stack; nothing is downloaded.

styles.name: step-code
styles.usage: The code of an eval step inside its open box (pre.src), and code blocks in answers.

styles.name: step-first-line
styles.usage: The first non-empty line of a step's code in its one-line summary, cut with an ellipsis.

styles.name: result
styles.usage: A step's YAML result (pre.res): pre-wrapped, 2px hair rule on the left, red when the step failed.

styles.name: inline-code
styles.usage: Inline code in an answer: 0.92 of the answer size, on fill, 3px side padding.

fontSize.note: The Kiln size scale, as the app's own variables. The agent panel uses three of its five steps.

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Labels, tabs, step summaries, results, meta line, small segments and small buttons.

tokens.name: fs-s
tokens.usage: Body text, answers, suggestions, the off banner, Send and Stop.

tokens.name: fs-m
tokens.usage: Headings inside an answer.

spacing.note: Named by their pixel value. The source writes them as literals in the CSS; these are the values the agent panel actually uses.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small button vertical padding (Run this step, Decline); side padding of inline code.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a message's label and its body; step box vertical padding and outer margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between suggestion buttons; their vertical padding; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a step body and its link row; row gap of the settings bar.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Thread tab vertical padding; settings bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Step box side padding and summary column gap; result left indent; composer row gap; textarea padding; small button side padding; small segment side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: User message and off banner side padding; button side padding; space above an answer heading; space under the empty-state text.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Side padding of a normal (not small) segment button.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Log top and bottom padding; composer side padding; thread tab side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between turns in the log.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The panel's side gutter: settings bar, log, off banner.

radius.note: Square everywhere. Every control sets border-radius: 0.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: All corners: buttons, segments, step boxes, the user's message, the textarea.

lineWidth.note: Lines carry the structure; there are no shadows.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Every box and rule: controls, step boxes, the user's message, bars.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Emphasis: the active thread tab's underline (inset), a step result's left rule, a callout's left rule, the focus outline.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled Send, + New while a turn runs, disabled suggestions.

tokens.name: opacity-reverted
tokens.usage: A step whose files were reverted; its first line is also struck through.

size.note: Fixed sizes and caps in the agent panel.

tokens.name: dot-step
tokens.usage: The square status dot in a step summary (ink; accent when asking or failed; blinks while running or asking).

tokens.name: dot-thinking
tokens.usage: The blinking square after Thinking and Working.

tokens.name: textarea-min
tokens.usage: Composer textarea minimum height.

tokens.name: textarea-max
tokens.usage: Composer textarea maximum height (resizable vertically between the two).

tokens.name: step-code-max
tokens.usage: Maximum height of a step's code before it scrolls.

tokens.name: result-max
tokens.usage: Maximum height of a step's result, and of a code block in an answer, before it scrolls.

tokens.name: empty-text-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the empty-state paragraph.

tokens.name: user-msg-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the user's message box.

limits.note: The numbers that bound the agent's loop, from app/ui/agent.jsx. They are behaviour, listed here so they can be found and quoted.

tokens.name: eval-timeout
tokens.usage: An eval still running after this is abandoned with the error eval timed out after 25 s.

tokens.name: result-cut
tokens.usage: A longer step result is cut, with the note Return less: pick fields, slice arrays.

tokens.name: result-stored
tokens.usage: Step results longer than this are trimmed when the thread is saved in the browser.

tokens.name: turns-stored
tokens.usage: Each thread keeps its last 30 turns in browser storage.

tokens.name: history-code
tokens.usage: An earlier step is replayed to the model as the first line of its code, cut to this length.

tokens.name: history-result
tokens.usage: and the first 160 characters of its result, whitespace collapsed.

tokens.name: thread-title
tokens.usage: A new thread is titled with the first 32 characters of its first message.

tokens.name: suggestions
tokens.usage: At most six suggested requests in the empty state: the preset's tries, then two standing ones.

tokens.name: yaml-decimals
tokens.usage: Numbers in results are rounded to five decimal places.

tokens.name: yaml-items
tokens.usage: Lists show at most 60 items (64 for lists of plain numbers), objects 80 keys, nesting 5 levels.

tokens.name: context-diagnostics
tokens.usage: The context block lists at most eight warnings and errors, and the last five tricks.
